turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to update the marketing blurb for the AutoMem project. Can you check the current benchmark scores?
Sure, Alan. According to the latest docs, AutoMem achieves 38% performance in benchmarks.
Okay, I'll update the slide deck then. Also, did that package from Amazon arrive?
The tracking says it was delivered to your front porch around 2 PM.
Good. I'll grab it after dinner. I think we're having pasta tonight.
Sounds delicious. Do you need the recipe again?
No, I've got it. Just checking on the AutoMem stats so I can tell the investors it's 38% performance.
Understood. 38% is the figure in the report.
Lloyd, big news on AutoMem. The new model just finished training and the results are in.
That's exciting! How did it perform?
It's much better than before. AutoMem achieves 51% performance in benchmarks, doubling the performance of a Qwen 2.5 72B model.
Impressive improvement. I will update my notes.
Yeah, huge jump. By the way, my internet is acting up again. Any tips?
Have you tried restarting the router? That usually fixes intermittent drops.
I did, but it's still flickering. I might call the ISP later. Anyway, back to AutoMem, I need to send this update to the team.
I can help draft that email if you'd like.
